mechanism: Both drugs can cause electrolyte disturbances and renal dysfunction; foscarnet causes hypocalcemia and hypomagnesemia while dorzolamide inhibits carbonic anhydrase leading to metabolic acidosis and electrolyte imbalances, with potential additive nephrotoxicity.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (calcium, magnesium, phosphate), and acid-base status closely; assess necessity of concurrent use and consider alternative therapies if possible.
